notes: Fixed: "Allow <tool> and continue" said "Resuming." and then sat there, and the only way on was Pause then Resume. The tool list is fixed when the agent starts, so a running agent could never see the new one — the button now restarts the session with it and sends the agent back to the step that was blocked.

Fixed: closing the app on a question and pressing Continue lost the question and carried on without you. The same card comes back and nothing moves until you answer. This now covers a run that had BLOCKED as well — the first version of the fix treated blocked as finished, so it restated its conclusions and re-read the whole ticket instead of waiting.

Fixed: "the host is unreachable, schema only until the VPN is up" while the VPN was up and SSMS was connected. Measured against the real server: unreachable 5 times out of 5 before, reachable 5 out of 5 after. The "Azure DevOps cannot be reached" banner shared the same fault.
A chat can now be opened on a folder where a fix is developing — it used to be refused. It opens read-only there: it reads and answers, and says what it would change rather than changing it.

A chat no longer surveys the repository when it opens — no fetch, no branch listing, no release sweep — unless the question needs it or you name a branch. Its opening instructions are about a third shorter as well.
New: Minimize on any card that asks you something — it rolls up to one line and keeps whatever you had typed.

New: the DBA's two SQL standards ship with the app. Table and column changes get the --@diagram tag and the MS_Description blocks; for a stored procedure the app tells you which release line the script targets and asks whether to apply the exception-handling framework.
The agent no longer writes comments into the code it changes — that belongs in the RCA.
Also carries 2.14.0: the 2.13.0 start-screen fix, and your real plan usage (the /usage figure) in the strip.
